Happy birthday amar jamayu. Ajke apni 24 year er hoy gesen — Allah apnar hayate onek borokot dan koruk, sob somoy happy thakhen.

Apnar ei 24 year er moddhe 8 year dhore ami apnar sathe achi — onek valobeshe, onek moja, hasi-kanna sob kichu kore amra aaj eksathe achi.

Apni sobsomoy amar sathe thakhben etai chai, ami apnake sarajibon valobashbo. Eksathe thakhbo, apnio amake onek valobashiyen, onek respect koriyen — eitai amar chawa.

Ajker apnar birthday te sob cheye beshi khusi ami. Apnar wife, apnar sob kichu. Apni onek valo kori janen ei diner jonno koto excited thaki ami — sobsomoy apnake amar sathe happy dekhte chai.

I love you sooo much, and Happy Birthday to you once again 💚
